::: {#fig-graph-three-points}

```{r}
#| label: graph-three-points-alt
#| include: false
fig_alt <- paste(
  "A plot with three filled points at (-1, 1), (0, 0) and (2, 4).",
  "A faint parabola passes through them,",
  "but the parabola is drawn lightly",
  "because only the three points belong to the graph.",
  "A hollow point at (1, 1) marks a pair that is not in the graph."
)
```

```{r}
#| label: graph-three-points-plot
#| fig-alt: !expr fig_alt
graph_points <- data.frame(a = c(-1, 0, 2), value = c(-1, 0, 2)^2)
parabola <- data.frame(a = seq(-1.5, 2.5, length.out = 201))
parabola$value <- parabola$a^2

graph_three_points_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    data = parabola,
    ggplot2::aes(x = a, y = value),
    colour = "grey80"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = graph_points,
    ggplot2::aes(x = a, y = value, colour = "in the graph"),
    size = 3
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = data.frame(a = 1, value = 1),
    ggplot2::aes(x = a, y = value, colour = "not in the graph"),
    shape = 1,
    size = 3,
    stroke = 1.2
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("in the graph" = "#0072B2", "not in the graph" = "#D55E00")
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = -1:2) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Input, a", y = "Output, f(a) = a^2", colour = NULL) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  htmltools::div(
    role = "img",
    `aria-label` = fig_alt,
    plotly::ggplotly(graph_three_points_plot) |>
      plotly::layout(legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2))
  )
} else {
  graph_three_points_plot
}
```

The [graph](#def-graph) of $f(a) = a^2$ on the [domain](#def-domain) $\set{-1, 0, 2}$.
The pair $(1, 1)$ lies on the curve $y = a^2$ but not in the graph of $f$, because $1$ is not in the domain.

:::
